description: This Java class 'BomBuilder' generates bill of materials (BOM) reports based on component data and PCB layout files. It reads input files such as component CSV, PCB design, and BOM dictionary, then produces detailed and compact BOM outputs with configurable options.

classes.name: BomBuilder
classes.description: Main class responsible for building and writing BOM reports based on PCB and component data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for execution, processes input arguments, loads files, and initiates BOM generation.

methods.name: writeMissingElements
methods.description: Identifies and logs components missing from BOM dictionary and removes them from active lists.

methods.name: writeFullPartList
methods.description: Generates a detailed 'full' BOM CSV with all components, indicating unmounted parts.

methods.name: writeCompactPartList
methods.description: Generates a summarized 'compact' BOM CSV with concise component listings.

methods.name: writeCommonHeader
methods.description: Writes header metadata to the BOM output files.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Outputs a line of BOM data with selected fields based on configuration.

methods.name: readBomDictionary
methods.description: Parses BOM dictionary CSV data into internal map of components.

methods.name: findModule
methods.description: Checks whether a component reference exists on the PCB layout.
